queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__md_items ( mdi_id int(10) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, tag enum('div','h2','h3','h4','h5') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'div', is_faq char(1) CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', is_open char(1) CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y', status char(1) CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', position int(5) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', position_on_page char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'I', item_type varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL, filling_type varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL, filling_data text CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (mdi_id) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__md_item_descriptions ( mdi_id int(10) UNSIGNED NOT NULL, lang_code char(2) CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL, title varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL, description text CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (mdi_id,lang_code) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__md_items_links ( id int(10) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, object_id int(10) NOT NULL, object_type varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8 NOT NULL, item_id int(10) NOT NULL, link_type char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'I', PRIMARY KEY (id), KEY object_id (object_id,object_type), KEY item_id (item_id) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__md_item_settings ( item_id int(11) not null, object_type varchar(50) not null, status char(1) not null default 'N', is_global char(1) not null default 'N', primary key (item_id,object_type) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
